Subject: Follow-up & pricing options from today's call

Hi Ishan / Maya \—

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Primary use case: API-based summarization + conversational retrieval for customer support transcripts (avg input length ~2k tokens).
- Expected steady-state volumes: 200M–400M tokens/month in Q4 if pilot converts. Peak spikes to ~600M tokens/month for batch re-ingests.
- Latency SLO: P95 generation target <= 1.2s for 512-token responses.
- Data residency: US-only for now.

Pricing/units we discussed:
- Baseline unit: $/1M input+output tokens.
- For planning, you mentioned a target blended rate goal around $600–$900 per 1M tokens.

Attached is a simple pricing worksheet with 3 options: self-serve hosted, 6‑month committed, and 12‑month committed with multi-year incentive. The committed tiers assume a 20–40% commit vs on-demand usage and include preferred capacity routing and 24x7 priority support.

Short asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm the conservative monthly token target for a contracted pilot (min commit) \— is 200M/month workable?
2) Any restrictions from procurement on multi-year commitments or PO cadence?

Next steps:
- Ishan will check with Maya/procurement on budget range and commit comfort.
- I can send a formal committed-use term sheet + a draft SOW (attached) if you want to scope pilot acceptance criteria.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-pricing-breakdown-committed.xlsx (pricing worksheet), starter-sow-draft.pdf (pilot SOW template)

From: Ishan Patel <ishan@brightlayer.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up & pricing options from today's call

Thanks Marissa \— helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- The 200M/month is probably the lower bound we can agree to for a pilot commitment. Our finance lead (Maya) wants to see committed pricing that gets us under $700/1M tokens blended to make the economics work for the pilot.
- We expect steady state after adoption to trend toward 350–450M/month.
- Procurement flagged approval windows \— they prefer annual POs rather than multi-year locked billing, but are open to multi-year discounts if the contract includes termination with 90d notice and pro-rata refunds for unused committed credits.

Questions:
1) What discount do you typically give for a 12‑month committed spend at 3.5B tokens/year?
2) Do you have startup / early-customer programs that would stack with committed discounts?

I'll loop Maya on the thread.

---Ishan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ishan Patel <ishan@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@brightlayer.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up & pricing options from today's call

Hi Ishan / Maya \—

Appreciate the details. To answer your questions at a high level (we can push exact numbers into the worksheet if you want):

- Typical 12‑month committed discount: 25–35% off list hosted on-demand rate, varying by commit size and included SLAs. For a 3.5B tokens/year commitment (~292M/month avg) we'd expect to be in the ~30% range assuming standard support and reserved capacity.
- Startup program: We do run a startup program that provides an additional one-time credit + a stacking discount for qualifying early-stage customers (usually seed–Series A, with verification). That can effectively lower the first-year blended $/1M by an additional 10–15% depending on credits applied.
- Multi-year incentives: We can structure a 2‑year agreement with year-1 commit + optional year-2 commit at a pre-negotiated uplift. Procurement-friendly terms like annual PO billing and 90-day termination with pro-rata refunds are workable \— we'll surface those in the term sheet.

Example blended math (very rough):
- On-demand list: $1,000 / 1M tokens
- 12‑month commit (30%): $700 / 1M
- Apply startup credit / promotion (~12% effective first-year): ~$616 / 1M blended for year 1

If your target is <$700 / 1M blended, the 12‑month commit + startup credit gets you there in Year 1. For long-term unit economics at scale (350–450M/month) we can also discuss additional volume tiers that push the blended under $600/1M.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa to send updated worksheet that samples the 3 scenarios with the exact math per your token curves (attached).
- Maya to confirm if BrightLayer can commit to a 12-month pilot at 200–300M/month minimum, or if procurement requires annual PO-only language (we can adapt).
- If agreeable, we can get a draft term sheet + SOW over and aim to have commercial terms reviewed next week.

Looping Ben to handle legal/commercial questions and Aditya to confirm capacity planning for the reserved pool.

Thanks \— happy to hop on another quick call if useful.

Best,
Marissa
